reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and also routes setZero's private copy of that query through it.

duplication.why: Removes setZero's duplicated selection SQL and factors the income guard into shouldBudgetCategory shared by setZero, setBulkNMonthAvg and the new action.

placement.why: Action and helper live in budget/actions.ts with the sibling month-wide actions; registered undoable in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Small adjacent consolidation of setZero and the income guard beyond the strict request, though directly related; copyPreviousMonth's inline guard is left as is.

maintainability.why: Which categories month-wide actions fill is now decided in one selection function plus one predicate used by all bulk actions it touches.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getBulkBudgetCategories and the new shouldBudgetCategory.
